bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:2552a0fb-18af-.title: Advertising Partnerships Manager
bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:2552a0fb-18af-.description: Bumble Inc. is looking for an experienced, motivated, and resourceful Advertising Partnerships Manager to drive revenue across our app portfolio. As one of the first members of our Ads team — sitting within the Product & Business Operations organization — you’ll help shape the future of Bumble’s advertising strategy. This is a sales role first and foremost, focused on building high-value advertising partnerships with brands and agencies, driving direct revenue, and managing campaigns from pitch to execution. You’ll also play a key role in growing our business by bringing back marketplace feedback to inform go-to-market plans and influence our ad product roadmap. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of selling strategic digital advertising solutions, along with strong account and project management skills. You’re just as comfortable securing RFPs and crafting proposals as you are managing day-to-day client relationships and collaborating cross-functionally to deliver best-in-class campaigns.
responsibilities: Identify, prospect, and secure new advertising partnerships through proactive outbound outreach, cultivating strategic relationships, and building market awareness of Bumble’s growing in-app advertising capabilities.

Drive advertising revenue growth by managing, strengthening, and expanding relationships with brand and agency partners to deliver high-performing, strategic campaigns across Bumble’s portfolio of apps.
Manage both inbound advertiser interest and a robust outbound sales pipeline, ensuring a balanced approach to driving new business, test opportunities, and long-term growth.

Oversee end-to-end campaign execution — including gathering creative assets, coordinating timelines, and managing campaign setup — while partnering with Ad Operations to deliver accurate reporting, performance insights, and optimizations.
Resolve day-to-day operational issues swiftly to minimize revenue-impacting blockers and ensure client satisfaction.

Help shape Bumble’s advertising go-to-market strategy by gathering and synthesizing client feedback, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and influencing the sales strategy and ad product roadmap to drive innovation.

Develop and refine sales enablement tools — including insights, narratives, presentations, and case studies — to support revenue growth, client education, and marketplace positioning for this emerging offering.
Collaborate across Product, Marketing, Comms, Legal, Finance, and Engineering to ensure campaigns are executed flawlessly and strategic priorities are aligned across the business.
Serve as a key contributor to the global advertising sales strategy, partnering on high-priority initiatives and helping to launch new ad products, formats, and monetization opportunities worldwide.
qualifications: You bring advanced experience selling digital advertising solutions and are recognised as a trusted partner by brands, agencies, and internal stakeholders alike.
Typically requires 5+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.
You have a strong understanding of the European advertising ecosystem, including brand and agency dynamics, mobile app advertising, and both direct-sold and emerging ad solutions.
You’re confident owning complex deal cycles — from RFP response and proposal development through to negotiation, execution, and post-campaign analysis.
You apply AI thoughtfully in your work, using tools to enhance prospecting, proposal development, pipeline forecasting, and performance insights while staying curious about new capabilities.
You communicate with clarity and influence, tailoring narratives and presentations for senior client stakeholders and internal leaders with equal confidence.
You collaborate with purpose across global teams, take ownership of outcomes, and adapt plans as conditions evolve — demonstrating excellence through follow-through.
You’re motivated by Bumble’s mission and role-model our values through inclusive behaviour, sound judgment, and a commitment to building advertising that adds value for people, not just platforms.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:5625413d-dd61-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Agile Coach based in the United States. This role offers the opportunity to help technical teams adopt effective Agile practices and consistently deliver high-quality outcomes. You will serve as a facilitator, coach, and change agent, helping teams strengthen collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement. Working across technical teams, Product Owners, and stakeholders, you will remove delivery obstacles and create an environment where teams can perform at their best. You will facilitate core Scrum ceremonies, support backlog readiness, and help teams adapt their processes to evolving priorities. The role is well suited to an experienced Agile professional who can balance hands-on team coaching with strong stakeholder management. You’ll contribute to complex digital initiatives in a mission-driven environment where technology, innovation, and measurable impact are central to the work. Facilitate core Scrum events, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring productive communication, alignment, and collaboration. Coach teams on Agile principles, Scrum practices, ceremonies, and continuous improvement techniques to strengthen delivery effectiveness. Facilitate collaboration and communication between cross-functional team members, Product Owners, technical stakeholders, and other business partners. Apply functional and technical knowledge to support Scrum goals and contribute to solutions for moderately scoped and complex delivery challenges. Partner with Product Owners to refine, organize, and prioritize product backlogs, ensuring work is clearly defined and ready for upcoming sprints. Identify impediments, dependencies, risks, and roadblocks that may affect team progress and work with stakeholders to resolve them efficiently. Continuously assess team processes and introduce Agile practices, adaptations, and improvements that increase efficiency and delivery quality. Promote a culture of transparency, accountability, collaboration, open communication, and continuous learning. Help teams and stakeholders adapt to changing priorities while maintaining focus on delivery objectives and customer outcomes. Manage stakeholder expectations effectively, identifying misalignment early and recalibrating expectations when necessary. Support technical product portfolio management and contribute to client briefings, project updates, and status reporting. Apply strong organizational discipline and attention to detail to ensure projects, processes, and deliverables remain aligned with expectations. Requirements Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant education and experience. 7+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach, Project Manager, or in a closely related role managing projects, processes, and technical teams delivering web-based solutions. Demonstrated experience managing technical product portfolios and leading technical teams through complex delivery initiatives. Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum principles, practices, ceremonies, and continuous improvement methodologies. Experience facilitating cross-functional teams and working effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proven ability to identify and remove impediments, manage dependencies, and resolve delivery challenges. Experience creating and delivering client briefings, project updates, and executive or stakeholder status reports. Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to communicate clearly, influence effectively, and recalibrate expectations when priorities or circumstances change. jobgether-jobgether:lever:a57c214b-23a2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Administrative Estimator based in the United States. This is an excellent opportunity to join a dynamic team supporting sales, design, estimating, and project delivery activities within the electronic physical security industry. The role combines administrative coordination, proposal development, estimating support, and customer-focused collaboration. You will help prepare accurate proposals and cost estimates for projects ranging from high-volume, straightforward work to larger, multi-site initiatives. Working closely with sales teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders, you will help ensure projects are clearly scoped and commercially competitive. The position also provides exposure to access control, CCTV, and other physical security technologies. With training and hands-on experience, this role offers a strong pathway toward a long-term career in sales, estimating, or project support. It is well suited to an organized, proactive professional who enjoys learning, teamwork, and delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced environment. Prepare accurate and professional proposals using standardized company or customer templates, ensuring all required information is complete and clearly presented. Review project plans, specifications, and drawings to understand project scope, requirements, and deliverables. Assist with cost estimates for small, high-volume, low-complexity projects and contribute to estimates for larger, more complex, multi-site projects. Support the preparation and administration of installation projects throughout their life cycle, including project setup in financial and project management systems. Collaborate with sales teams to gather project information, clarify requirements, and ensure proposals align with customer expectations. Work with internal teams to address account- or project-specific requirements and maintain accurate proposal and estimate information. Use estimating tools and software to calculate basic material, labor, and overhead costs. Maintain organized records of proposals, project scopes, customer information, and other documentation required for reporting and follow-up. Act as a central source of information by maintaining, communicating, and distributing proposal and estimating details according to internal and customer requirements. Support quick-turn proposal requests and consistently work toward established deadlines and priorities. Communicate with vendors to obtain current material pricing and other information needed for estimates. Develop an understanding of access control, CCTV, and other electronic physical security systems to support accurate and competitive estimates. Contribute to a collaborative, customer-focused team environment and perform additional duties as required. Requirements: High school diploma, associate degree, or equivalent relevant experience. 1–3 years of experience in sales support, administrative support, estimating, project coordination, or a related field. Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and follow-through. Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with sales, estimating, design, vendors, and other internal teams. Strong customer service mindset and awareness of customer needs and satisfaction. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, and Outlook. Ability to manage multiple small tasks efficiently, prioritize deadlines, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment. Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. jobgether-jobgether:lever:b95e4b27-bc07-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AWS Cloud Engineer based in Turkey. This is a mid-level cloud engineering role focused on designing, deploying, and optimizing AWS environments for diverse client needs. You’ll work across a variety of cloud engagements, adapting solutions to different business requirements and technical challenges. The role combines hands-on infrastructure engineering with client advisory responsibilities, giving you the opportunity to influence cloud architecture and implementation. You’ll leverage infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, containerization, and automation to build reliable and scalable cloud environments. You’ll also identify infrastructure issues, improve performance and costs, and apply strong security practices throughout project delivery. The environment is dynamic and technology-focused, with opportunities to work across modern AWS services and evolving cloud technologies. This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and delivering practical cloud solutions for clients. Deploy, configure, and maintain modular cloud-based systems and infrastructure within AWS environments. Advise clients on the design, architecture, and implementation of modern AWS cloud technologies aligned with their business requirements. Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve infrastructure and application deployment challenges across cloud environments. Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management practices. Design and maintain secure AWS networking environments, including VPC configurations and related security controls. Optimize cloud operations by identifying opportunities to improve system performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency. Ensure data storage and processing solutions meet client requirements, policies, and operational standards. Apply AWS security best practices throughout architecture, deployment, configuration, and ongoing operations. Stay current with emerging AWS services, cloud engineering practices, automation technologies, and industry standards. Collaborate with engineering teams and clients to deliver effective solutions and adapt quickly to changing project requirements. Practical experience building or supporting CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, CircleCI, GitHub Actions , or comparable platforms. Experience configuring Kubernetes clusters and deploying applications in containerized environments. Solid understanding of AWS networking, VPC architecture, and cloud security principles. Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure and application deployment issues using structured analytical and problem-solving approaches. Experience identifying opportunities for AWS performance, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization. Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure automation and configuration management practices. Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and provide practical recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders. Strong adaptability and willingness to work across varied client environments and business requirements. An AWS Associate- or Professional-level certification is preferred. skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:06c01930-ae62-48e5.title: HRBP - Platform
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:06c01930-ae62-48e5.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. HR команда розробляє ефективні інструменти для залучення, адаптації та розвитку талантів, щоб команди в бізнесах і Платформі працювали злагоджено та досягали високих результатів. Задача команди – створити культуру, яка поєднує високу продуктивність з відчуттям причетності та стабільності. Чого ти зможеш досягти та втілювати разом із нами: — Бути бізнес-партнером CEO та лідерів бізнесу, допомагати формувати нові команди та адаптувати організаційну структуру; — Взяти на себе повний ownership за Employee Lifecycle у визначеному бізнесі; — Вдосконалювати процеси, які підсилюють бізнес: performance cycles, leadership development, feedback ecosystem, succession planning, organizational design; — Аналізувати дані про людей і командну динаміку, щоб ухвалювати стратегічні рішення (а не просто «проводити опитування»); — Будувати культуру високої ефективності, де амбіції, прозорість і відповідальність не суперечать людяності. Аби досягати цілей разом, для нас важливо: — Твій досвід 3+ років HRBP/People Partnership у динамічному середовищі; — Розуміння, як працює бізнес і вміння говорити мовою цифр, пріоритетів і впливу; — Досвід управління Employee Lifecycle — не просто координуючи процеси, а вибудовуючи їх як стратегічну систему; — Сильні навички будувати відносини з лідерами та ефективно комунікувати: домовлятись, аргументовано доводити свій погляд, знаходити win-win рішення, працювати з фідбеком як інструментом, управляти комунікаціями на рівні команди/робочої групи; — Сміливість брати відповідальність на себе, пропонувати нові ідеї, експериментувати, щоб швидше виконати роботу та покращити якість фінального результату; — Системне мислення: вміння бачити не тільки окремі кейси, а закономірності; — Сфокусованість на результаті та сенсі: вміння встановлювати пріоритети, відстежувати статус по своїх цілях, знаходити ресурси для досягнення мети, ставити собі запитання «Яку проблему ми вирішуємо?», дотримуватися дедлайнів. У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: — SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. — Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки. — Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо. — Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці — і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави. — Екосистема для продуктивної роботи.
